title: Envy of Matter and the Living Fires
description: The diagnostic dyad with which full integration begins. T74 — envy is the first motion of selfhood: looking at what flows from above and wanting it for oneself, not as gift received but as possession claimed; the original shape of self-love from which every later wickedness flows; she envies the First Man, the icon of the Ambassador, the formed Adam, and all the firstborn things and the cross. T75 — the eight dwellings of living love, divine love at every register where it can be received: in the ground of the natural, in the Father's own deep, in the armor of the Divine Human, in the two ships of day and night, in the Call going out, in the new land of pure receivability, in the Land of Light itself, and in the visible signs drawn from sun and moon. The soul has by now learned to feel the difference between envy and love at every register.
